gen-gf-bellota-gf-manjari: Quirky, confident lettering up top: Bellota hangs the ends of its s loosely and draws every stroke like one stylus. And Manjari, a sans-serif, keeps its curves open with a steady line, so shrinking the heading would lose the charm.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-meera-inimai: Meera Inimai reads like blueprint lettering, its open-ended curves holding a constant line with room to spare. Bellota does the showing off with a loose, hanging s, while Meera Inimai does the quiet, steady work of carrying the text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-moderustic: Rounded, stylus-drawn and a bit cheeky: that's Bellota, with an s whose ends dangle loose. Moderustic, a sans-serif, brings broad-nibbed curves left unfinished, and the gap in character between them is the pair's real appeal.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-molengo: Bellota draws true monoline strokes with an s whose ends dangle loose, giving the heading a confident, distinctive look. Molengo sits beside it feeling modern and restrained.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-mona-sans: Mona Sans reads wide and open, its letter openings like a door left ajar, a modern and measured voice for text. Bellota's constant pen-pressure lines give the heading more character.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-monda: Approachable in the body and bold in the heading, this pair rests on Monda's unclogged small counters. Bellota's wire-like strokes give it a distinct, sturdy look.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-murecho: Tubular strokes like bent copper pipe make Bellota instantly recognizable, with an s whose ends dangle loose. Murecho, a sans-serif, opens its s curves wide at both ends, so text flows smoothly and clean.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-linear-a: Letters sketched with a pencil that never presses harder give Bellota its look, and the dangling s ends add personality. Noto Sans Linear A answers with a visibly gaping c, a clean plain sans partner.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-mongolian: Bellota draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin, with an s whose ends hang loose. And Noto Sans Mongolian, a modern sans with flaring terminals, sits next to it with a lively, easygoing feel.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-noto-sans-nko: Bellota keeps every stroke from swelling or thinning, with an s whose ends dangle loose. But Noto Sans NKo, a modern plain sans, brings c openings you can see through, and that clarity is the pair's best quality.
